seoTitle: Buy Namecheap Hosting: Pricing, Plans & Discounts
metaDescription: Choosing Namecheap hosting? Learn how to compare plans, apply coupon codes, and unlock free extras like SSL, domain privacy, and email with your purchase.
intro: Namecheap offers a range of hosting plans, and getting the best value means understanding what each tier includes and how to apply available promo discounts before you buy. This guide walks through choosing a plan, applying coupons, and taking advantage of free features bundled in.

steps.heading: Compare available hosting plans
steps.body: Review the different Namecheap hosting tiers to see which fits your site's size and traffic needs before committing to a purchase.

steps.heading: Check for current promo discounts
steps.body: Look for available coupon codes or seasonal promotions that can reduce the price of your chosen plan.

steps.heading: Apply the coupon code at checkout
steps.body: Enter the promo code during checkout to make sure the discount is applied before completing your purchase.

steps.heading: Review included free features
steps.body: Confirm what's bundled with your plan, such as free SSL certificates, domain privacy, or email, so you know what you're getting beyond hosting.

steps.heading: Complete your purchase
steps.body: Finalize your order and check your confirmation to verify the plan, pricing, and included features match what you selected.

faq.question: Does Namecheap hosting come with a free SSL certificate?
faq.answer: Many Namecheap hosting plans include a free SSL certificate as part of the package, though it's worth confirming for your specific plan.

faq.question: How much can promo codes save on Namecheap hosting?
faq.answer: Discounts vary by promotion and time of year, so it's worth checking for the best available offer before purchasing.

faq.question: What's included with domain privacy?
faq.answer: Domain privacy hides your personal contact information from the public WHOIS database, which is often included as a free perk.

faq.question: Can I upgrade my hosting plan later?
faq.answer: Yes, Namecheap generally allows you to upgrade to a higher-tier plan if your site outgrows your current hosting.
